# Fuliong Hi-Tech Material Co., Ltd.

> > Fuliong Hi-Tech is a Chinese manufacturer and supplier of advanced protective textiles including fire-resistant, cut-resistant, chainsaw-protective, and electromagnetic shielding fabrics engineered for industrial safety applications.

Based in Jiaxing, China, Fuliong Hi-Tech specializes in high-performance fiber materials and protective textiles for industrial, occupational, and safety markets. The company offers both raw fabric materials and finished protective products with certifications including EN 381 and EN ISO11612 standards.

## Key Topics

- Protective Textiles
- Fire-Resistant Fabric
- Cut-Resistant Fabric
- Chainsaw-Protective Fabric
- Electromagnetic Shielding
- Para-aramid

## Protective Fabric Products

- [All Products](https://www.tex-safety.com/all-products): Complete product catalog of protective textiles and safety materials
- [Chainsaw Protective Fabric](https://www.tex-safety.com/anti-chainsaw-fabric): Chainsaw protective fabric with Kevlar/Dyneema, EN 381 compliance
- [Cut Resistant Fabric](https://www.tex-safety.com/cut-resistant-fabric): Cut resistant fabric with UHMWPE and aramid fiber technology
- [Fire and Heat Resistant Fabric](https://www.tex-safety.com/fire-and-heat-resistant-fabric): Fire and heat resistant fabrics with Kevlar and silica materials
- [Aluminized Fabric](https://www.tex-safety.com/aluminized-fabric): Aluminized fabric product page with EN ISO11612 fire protective standards
- [Abrasion Resistant Fabric](https://www.tex-safety.com/abrasion-resistant-fabric): Abrasion resistant fabric with nylon and polyester composition
- [Anti Electromagnetic Radiation Fabric](https://www.tex-safety.com/anti-electromagnetic-radiation-fabric): EMF shielding and RFID blocking Faraday fabric products
- [Reflective Fabric](https://www.tex-safety.com/reflective-fabric): Reflective fabric with glass bead technology for visibility enhancement
- [Chemical and Fire Protective Fabric](https://www.tex-safety.com/chemical-and-fire-protective-fabric): Chemical and fire protective fabric with para aramid composition
